description: NE_Test Cykelbarometrar-kartlager till kommunens externa webbkarta is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Örebro kommun. NETest Contains the following map layer for the municipality's external web map on örebro.se for content in the catalogue "Culture & Leisure": - Bicycle barometers. Coverage: Örebro kommun. The portal shows the English title as "NE_Test Cycle barometers-map warehouse to the municipality's external web map" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Örebro kommun. Its keywords include Örebro kommun, Bibliotek, oregelbundet. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMTS, PNG, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2025-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
